findings.title: Virtual machine OS disk without encryption
findings.description: azurerm_linux_virtual_machine / azurerm_windows_virtual_machine os_disk without disk_encryption_set_id stores the OS disk with platform-managed keys. Use a disk encryption set.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For storage accounts set `infrastructure_encryption_enabled = true` and use a customer-managed key via `azurerm_key_vault_key`. For regulated data use a customer-managed key in Key Vault with purge protection and key rotation.

findings.title: Virtual machine without managed identity
findings.description: azurerm_linux_virtual_machine without identity block cannot use managed identities. Configure a system-assigned identity.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Azure security best practices and the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Virtual machine without encryption at host
findings.description: azurerm_virtual_machine / azurerm_linux_virtual_machine / azurerm_windows_virtual_machine without encryption_at_host_enabled = true leaves VM data unencrypted at the host layer. Enable encryption at host.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For storage accounts set `infrastructure_encryption_enabled = true` and use a customer-managed key via `azurerm_key_vault_key`. For regulated data use a customer-managed key in Key Vault with purge protection and key rotation.

findings.title: Virtual machine without secure boot
findings.description: azurerm_linux_virtual_machine / azurerm_windows_virtual_machine with secure_boot_enabled = false (or absent) boots without UEFI secure boot, allowing rootkit persistence. Enable secure boot with a trusted launch configuration.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Azure security best practices and the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Virtual machine without boot diagnostics
findings.description: azurerm_virtual_machine / azurerm_linux_virtual_machine / azurerm_windows_virtual_machine without a boot_diagnostics block loses serial console and screenshot evidence needed for incident response. Enable boot diagnostics with a managed storage account.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against Azure security best practices and the CIS Microsoft Azure Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
